events.title: Gravel Bar Camp, Ogilvie River, YT
events.thought: End of day fifty-eight. Camped on a wide gravel bar along the Ogilvie River — the kind of spot that makes you forget about mileage.
events.photoCaption: Camp on a gravel bar along the Ogilvie River, Yukon.

events.title: Tombstone Range from the Ridge
events.thought: Standing above Tombstone Park's valley — those dark spires live rent-free in your head forever.
events.photoCaption: co-Navigator looks out from an alpine ridge over the jagged Tombstone peaks and glacial valley, Yukon.
